svg.title: First Light · Commit calendar for hyyyyyyz
svg.desc: 1,704 public commit contributions from 2025-11-19 through 2026-11-18. A single Franka Panda plays First Light with an arcade blaster. Every active date goes dark on impact. After the last tile the lunar antenna opens, sends a signal and raises the victory pennant.
svg.metadata: Panda geometry from Franka Robotics via MuJoCo Menagerie, Apache-2.0. First Light artwork and choreography by Antikythera.
